description.p: LibreNotes is a cross-device note-taking app that syncs through your own self-hosted server. Notes are end-to-end encrypted — the server only ever stores ciphertext. Works fully offline and syncs opportunistically whenever your home server is reachable.

ul.li: Markdown note editing with live preview
Self-hosted sync server — no third-party cloud, LAN-only by design
Offline-first: full functionality without network access
Conflict resolution: choose the winning version when edits collide
Trash bin with restore and permanent delete
